title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. The street ahead is empty.
scene: Overcast midday on a two-lane downtown street. The Menace is in the right travel lane, moving. The carrier sits on the floor to the right of the tunnel, door latched, a strap around the box and the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange with a cream chest, brown with a dark stripe — visible through the grate. Ahead through the mesh, the wet two-lane continues empty: skip-dashed paint, brick storefronts, no person in the road. The full-width nose plow on the front bull bar points down the travel lane. The right foot covers the brake — heel planted, ball hovering. The cats are cargo in a closed box. The street stays readable because the load stays on the floor.
debrief: Animals ride in a closed, strapped carrier. The load stays on the floor so the street stays visible.

source.teaching_target: Pets ride in a closed, strapped carrier while moving; the load stays on the floor so the street stays visible.
